instruction: In booking.py, introduce a dataclass Stay with fields room_type: str, nights: int, guests: int, breakfast: bool (in that order), and change quote(room_type, nights, guests, breakfast) to quote(stay) taking one Stay. cheapest keeps its signature cheapest(nights, guests, breakfast) and builds a Stay for each room it compares. Update tests/test_booking.py to construct Stay objects. Change nothing else.
notes: rope has introduce_parameter (a single parameter), not a parameter object.
